claim: Recover useful representations, establish and preserve alignment, and extend governance under existing obligations.
topology: Three complementary practices for an existing system. Recover models by distinguishing legitimate implementation patterns, latent concepts worth representing, and mechanical cleanup. Active alignment changes implementation until obligations hold; passive alignment checks subsequent changes against the retained models. Expand the alignment kernel incrementally while protecting established obligations.
bw_encoding: White default; light-gray fill identifies latent model concepts, explicit model obligations and the protected kernel. Rounded mechanisms, square representations/outcomes, and nested governed surfaces retain the Chapter 4 vocabulary. Solid arrows express local process or branching; nested circles express containment, not data flow. Headings are bold, explanations regular.
redesign: Author-requested geometry compression from 444 x 224 bp to 444 x 184 bp (17.86% less height). Labels remain 10 pt; strokes and semantic relationships are unchanged. Shorter gaps and repeat loop, aligned panel tops/bottoms, and less whitespace around the nested kernel preserve legibility.
alt: Three complementary practices for an existing system. Recover models by distinguishing legitimate implementation patterns, latent concepts worth representing, and mechanical cleanup. Active alignment changes implementation until obligations hold; passive alignment checks subsequent changes against the retained models. Expand the alignment kernel incrementally while protecting established obligations.
